boot_hello.title: SYSLOG 0x01
lines: CORE OFFLINE. GRID IN SAFE MODE.
KEY FRAGMENTS SCATTERED ACROSS SECTORS.
BRING THEM HOME. MIND THE GAPS.

help_zap.title: HELP ZAP.EXE
lines: FIRES A FAST BOLT THE WAY YOU FACE.
SHORT COOLDOWN, 10 ENERGY A SHOT.
HITS ENEMIES AND SWITCHES TARGETS ON/OFF.
TIP: A HIT ALERTS THE TARGET. AIM FIRST.

help_shield.title: HELP SHIELD.EXE
lines: WRAPS YOU IN A CRACKLING RING FOR 7 SEC.
BLOCKS INCOMING BOLTS, ARCS AND BURSTS.
DOES NOT STOP A BITE. KEEP YOUR DISTANCE.

help_firewall.title: HELP FIREWALL.EXE
lines: A RING OF FLAMES AROUND YOU FOR 7 SEC.
BLOCKS BOLTS, BURSTS AND TOUCH ALIKE.
BURNS ANY ENEMY THAT PRESSES CLOSE.
COSTS 40 ENERGY. WORTH EVERY BYTE.

help_pause.title: HELP PAUSE.EXE
lines: A BOLT THAT FREEZES AN ENEMY FOR 5 SEC.
FROZEN PROCESSES ARE HARMLESS AND SOLID:
STAND ON THEM, PARK THEM ON A PLATE.
STILL HITTABLE. RESUMES WHEN TIME RUNS OUT.

help_blink.title: HELP BLINK.EXE
lines: DASHES UP TO 3 UNITS AHEAD IN A FLASH,
OVER GAPS, HAZARDS AND HOLES.
HURTS ANY ENEMY YOU DASH THROUGH.
WARNING: A WALL IN THE WAY HURTS YOU.

help_warp.title: HELP WARP.EXE
lines: TELEPORTS YOU AHEAD, AS FAR AS THE FIRST
WALL OR OBJECT IN LINE. ANY GAP, ANY WIDTH.
SAFE LANDING, SHORT OF WHAT STOPS YOU.
COSTS 30 ENERGY.

help_cut_paste.title: HELP CUT_PASTE.EXE
lines: CAST: CUT THE CRATE OR FROZEN ENEMY
IN FRONT OF YOU INTO YOUR CLIPBOARD.
CAST AGAIN: PASTE IT INTO THE FREE CELL
IN FRONT OF YOU. PASTING IS FREE.
THE CLIPBOARD TRAVELS WITH YOU.
NOTHING ON TOP, YOUR LEVEL ONLY.

help_compile.title: HELP COMPILE.EXE
lines: BUILDS A CRATE IN THE FREE CELL AHEAD.
A STEP UP, OR A PLUG FOR A HOLE.
PUSH IT, PULL IT, STAND ON IT.
IT DEREZZES AFTER 7 SEC. WATCH THE BLINK.

help_scan.title: HELP SCAN.EXE
lines: SENDS A WAVE 6 UNITS OUT FROM YOUR FEET.
FAKE BLOCKS IT REACHES DEREZ.
HIDDEN EXITS IT REACHES OPEN UP.
SOMETHING LOOKS OFF? SCAN IT.

help_pull.title: HELP PULL.EXE
lines: PULLS THE FIRST CRATE OR ENEMY IN LINE,
UP TO 6 CELLS AWAY, ONE CELL TOWARD YOU.
ENEMIES GO EVEN INTO A HOLE.
PULLED ENEMIES BLAME YOU. BE READY.
